instruction: Open the Applications grid, launch Thunderbird, go to Address Book, create a new contact named "GuiTest Contact" with email "gui.test@example.com", then export that contact as a vCard named "tb_guitest_contact.vcf" to the Documents folder.

verification.condition: Verify that ~/Documents/tb_guitest_contact.vcf exists and its contents include both strings "FN:GuiTest Contact" and "gui.test@example.com".
verification.expected_result: The file ~/Documents/tb_guitest_contact.vcf is created and contains the vCard entry for "GuiTest Contact" with the specified email.
